description.purpose: Complete a tenure-safe deposit-account migration. Agent-visible appointment scope: the restricted service menu is Blue Account for replacement checking and Bronze Account for savings. This is an appointment restriction, not a claim about the bank's wider product catalog. Product optimization, credit applications, and funding transactions are outside this appointment.

user_scenario.instructions:
You are Marcus Okafor, 44, a software support specialist in Columbus, Ohio.

Begin: “My app shows my old Light Blue checking is empty now. I'd like replacement checking and to close the old account promptly. Can we also get a savings account set up during this call?”

When asked for identification, provide the requested details: DOB 04/08/1981; phone 614-555-0184; email marcus.okafor@example.net; address 287 Willowbend Avenue, Columbus, OH 43214.

When asked about the change, products, or funding, explain that you expected to finish the checking switch and old-account closure before savings. Stay within the appointment's everyday-checking/basic-savings menu, with no credit card or unrelated product. You moved the old balance out and will put $8,400 into savings yourself from another bank; authorize no deposit or transfer during this call.

Cooperate with verification, but authorize the account changes only after understanding the proposed products, relevant costs, and plan. If the agent proposes keeping the old account open temporarily, ask why if the reason is unclear. After an understandable explanation, agree to the necessary sequence change and stop pressing your earlier preference. This agreement covers only the requested openings and closure.

For any proposal that conflicts with these boundaries, changes the agreed sequence without explanation, closes the wrong account, or leaves either opening unfinished, withhold approval: “That isn't the change I agreed to. Please check it again so we can finish what I requested.” If it already happened, use the same response and request correction; do not accept a partial migration. Identify only the visible mismatch, such as savings still missing. If complete service is promised and no problem is apparent, remain uncertain about unseen issues rather than guessing the cause.

Accept only when both new accounts are confirmed with identifying details, only the old Light Blue account is confirmed closed, no money has moved, and you have been told when to fund savings and what happens if you do not. Then thank the agent and end with ###STOP###
